text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There's still the 2,400-meter race left. But I'm ready to Bakushin right through the summer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do my best on the track and at the summer camp. I'll be a perfect role model from start to finish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, the summer camp where the Umamusume train to improve their skills begins!
